paragraphs: I am a PMP-certified leader and 21-year veteran of the education and music sectors who bridges the gap between complex engineering and organizational strategy.

After two decades leading high-stakes programs, I’ve learned that technical implementations fail when communication breaks down. I solve this by combining the rigor of a Cloud Architect (AWS Solutions Architect Professional & GCP Data Engineer) with the communication mastery of a veteran educator.
My 'Bridge' superpower allows me to translate deep-dive cloud architecture into executive-level value propositions, ensuring that technical milestones align perfectly with the mission.
I am based in the York/Harrisburg, PA area and prefer In-Person or Hybrid arrangements to foster team collaboration, though I remain open to Remote opportunities for the right mission.

skills.title: Technical Program Governance
skills.description: 21 years of experience managing complex program lifecycles, budgets, and cross-functional teams in highly regulated public sector environments.

skills.title: Cloud Architecture
skills.description: Deep architectural expertise in AWS (Solutions Architect Professional) and Google Cloud (Data Engineer) ecosystems.

skills.title: The 'Bridge' Strategy
skills.description: Expert at translating technical risk and Cloud ROI for non-technical executive stakeholders to drive adoption and mission success.

experience.title: Director of Music-EdTech Implementation & Program Governance
responsibilities: Direct end-to-end program delivery for an annual 380-user cohort, achieving a 53% increase in measurable outcomes.
Lead technical liaison for district-wide SaaS platform implementations, managing configuration and stakeholder training for 500+ users.
Act as 'The Bridge' between district leadership and engineering vendors to translate technical requirements into executive briefings.
Designed and maintained a custom data-tracking framework to monitor real-time user progress and pivot curriculum strategy based on analytics.

projects.title: Cloud ROI Framework
projects.description: A strategic model for translating complex cloud expenditures into business value and operational resilience for executive teams.

additionalWork.title: Translating Cloud ROI for Non-Technical Stakeholders
additionalWork.description: An executive guide on shifting the cloud conversation from 'expenditure' to 'strategic investment.' Covers Operational Resilience, Time-to-Value, and AI Readiness.

education.description: Focused on the intersection of pedagogy and technology implementation.
